answer: Require an atlas check: each identity must present two independent verifiable histories, such as a code contribution record and a settled payment record, corroborating the same operator over time. One honest agent passes once at under $10. A Sybil farmer must forge both histories per fake identity, and any mismatch drops it to nadir trust and freezes its rewards. Forging one history costs about $200 in aged accounts and fees, but a consistent pair costs over $800, so 100 fakes cost $80,000. An opal seal issued only after both histories verify lets any peer re-audit the pair.
